title: Expose consistent projections and decision explanations
summary: Provide read operations applications can render without rebuilding matter semantics in the UI. Explanations should distinguish current understanding, historical knowledge, unresolved evidence, and actual delivery outcomes.
implementation: Define consistent scoped queries with as-of boundaries, redirects, and incomplete flags.
Compose explanations from actual rule decisions and operation receipts, retaining citations and disagreement.
Resolve immutable references once and expose unavailable retained material.
Prevent projections from combining incompatible identity, assessment, and delivery revisions during concurrent changes.

acceptance.criterion: Quiet explanations distinguish already delivered from inadequate coverage.
acceptance.verification: Query fixtures with those different reason paths.

acceptance.criterion: Historical explanation uses its original policy and knowable evidence.
Missing payload produces unavailable reconstruction rather than generated justification.
acceptance.verification: Remove a permitted test blob and inspect completeness.

tests: A loser ID redirects while retaining its history.
A concurrent split cannot yield mixed-revision projection.
risks: Presentation code may derive a different status than the core.

reuse.application: Use server-derived status and cited claims as a projection pattern without civic UI dependencies.
